order_wins: **Refex Industries** — bags a **Rs 160 crore contract from a public sector undertaking in Madhya Pradesh for the lifting of 10 MT of pond ash and fly ash** under road-cum-rail mode, over 18 months extendable by mutual consent _(~4.3% of mcap)_.

**East India Drums and Barrels Manufacturing** — is awarded a **Rs 59.02 crore contract through the Government e-Marketplace by Hindustan Petroleum for the supply of IS-3575 bitumen drums**, to run two years _(~42.2% of mcap)_.

**Cosmic CRF** — the company and two subsidiaries, N.S. Engineering Projects and Cosmic Springs & Engineers, book **purchase orders of Rs 14.14 crore, Rs 11.80 crore and Rs 5.90 crore from an engineering and infrastructure customer in Kolkata** for fabricated structural steel, each within three months _(~2.7% of mcap; the Rs 31.84 crore total is our sum)_.
**Vdeal System** — receives an order from **Mogli Labs (India) for the supply of a power distribution system, Rs 5.40 crore**, for delivery by 15 January 2027.

**United Drilling Tools** — receives a **domestic order from ONGC for the supply of stabilizers, an estimated Rs 4.78 crore**, to be executed in six months and in the ordinary course of business _(~1.1% of mcap)_.

**Chiraharit** — receives a **Rs 0.60 crore purchase order from the Northern Region Farm Machinery Training & Testing Institute at Hissar** for the supply of a centre-pivot irrigation system, installation included _(~1.1% of mcap)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Gconnect Logitech and Supply Chain** — board approves **raising up to Rs 41 crore from existing shareholders through a rights issue** of Rs 10 face-value equity shares, subject to regulatory approvals; a revised outcome of the same meeting was filed later the same day.
equity_allotments: **Hiliks Technologies** — allots **23,00,000 equity shares at Rs 72, Rs 16.56 crore, to five non-promoters including Aegis Investment Fund PCC at 9.15% and Niveza Small Cap Fund at 4.93%**, with 11,50,000 convertible warrants at the same price a quarter paid up _(~26.9% of mcap)_.

**Sumeet Industries** — allots **84,31,195 equity shares at Rs 33.21 to six non-promoters on conversion of optionally convertible redeemable preference shares, Rs 28.00 crore**, the preference shares having been issued in December 2024 under its NCLT-approved resolution plan, so no fresh cash comes in _(~4.2% of mcap)_.

**Dhansafal Finserve** — converts **1,00,00,000 warrants held by Luharuka Exports into equity on receipt of the balance 75%, Rs 3.23 crore**, taking that holder to 23.50% of an enlarged 23,71,40,000 shares _(~5.9% of mcap)_.
m_and_a: **Shivalic Power Control** — completes the purchase of **51% of Seedlab Ventures for Rs 1.43 lakh in cash**, a related-party buy from its own promoter group meant to take it into solar parks; the filing revises the price from the Rs 1.37 lakh it first reported.
**Electrosteel Castings** — pays **OMR 21,000 for 14,000 shares, 70% of Arabian Water Tech LLC of Oman**, and has received the share certificate, making the water-treatment company a subsidiary.

**K.M. Sugar Mills** — fixes **1 October as the effective date and 2 October as the record date for the NCLT-sanctioned demerger of its distillery division into KM Spirits and Allied Industries**, one Rs 10 share for every five Rs 2 shares held.

**Himadri Speciality Chemical** — will put to its board on **21 September a scheme of arrangement demerging the tyre business of Dalmia Bharat Refractories into the company**, and has closed its trading window until 48 hours after the outcome.

**MPS** — the NCLT at Chennai, by an order of **16 September on the second-motion petition for the amalgamation of ADI BPO Services into the company**, takes the shareholder and creditor approvals of 22 August on record and directs notice to the statutory authorities.

**Veranda Learning Solutions** — the Regional Director, Southern Region, **approves amalgamating wholly owned Veranda IAS Learning Solutions and step-down Neyyar Academy into Veranda Race Learning Solutions**; the company states this is distinct from its Commerce-vertical demerger.

**Shreenath Paper Products** — board approves buying **25,000 shares of associate Shreenath Paper Industries from Bijoy Ramesh Shah for Rs 2.50 lakh at face value**, lifting its holding from 50% to 75% and making it a subsidiary.

**Sainik Finance & Industries** — receives a Regulation 10(7) report for an **off-market inter-se transfer of 13,16,066 shares, 12.10% of its paid-up capital, among its promoters and promoter group**.
business_updates: **Results season** — 2 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Tirupati Forge** — receives an **industrial licence under the Indian Arms Act, 1959 to manufacture empty artillery shells** in calibres from 105mm to 155mm, including ERFB and base-bleed 155mm variants, on an initial capability of 150,000 units a year.

**MOS Utility** — subsidiary Samvriddhi Inclusive Growth Network **receives in-principle authorisation from the Reserve Bank of India to operate as an online payment aggregator**, subject to final authorisation, adding merchant payments to its business-correspondent network.
distress_risk: **Goldiam International** — receives a **Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation property-tax demand of Rs 23.55 crore on its SEEPZ premises covering 1 April 2010 to 31 March 2026**, which it says it is examining and will take legal action to defend against.

**JSW Energy** — the Appellate Tribunal for Electricity **sets aside a 2022 CERC order and allows step-down subsidiary JSW Hydro Energy's claim for notional interest during construction on equity above 30%**, remanding the data to CERC for a prudence check.

**Teerth Gopicon** — its **first committee of creditors approved 11 of 27 resolutions and rejected 16 on 1.32% support**, among them the confirmation of the interim resolution professional, who therefore continues as deemed resolution professional.
**Astron Paper and Board Mill** — under insolvency since 11 May, convened the **fifth meeting of its committee of creditors on 18 September**.
credit_rating_changes: **CMR Green Technologies** — CRISIL **upgrades the long-term rating to AA-/Stable from A+/Stable and the short-term rating to A1+ from A1**, on bank facilities enhanced to Rs 953 crore from Rs 760.74 crore.

**Indo Farm Equipment** — Infomerics **upgrades it to IVR A/Stable and IVR A1 on Rs 103.70 crore of bank facilities**, citing deleveraging, a 14.39% rise in FY26 operating income and a structural cut in its exposure to subsidiary Barota Finance.
**Gopal Snacks** — CRISIL **reaffirms A and A1 on Rs 150.31 crore of bank facilities but revises the long-term outlook to Negative from Stable**.

**Century Extrusions** — refiles its 17 September intimation to say the rating action was misstated: Infomerics **reaffirmed IVR BBB and revised the outlook to Positive**, rather than upgrading the long-term rating as first reported.
other_notable: **Kalyan Jewellers India** — subscribes **Rs 350 crore to a rights issue of 17,50,000 shares by wholly owned Candere Lifestyle Jewellery**, the stated object being repayment of loans Kalyan itself had extended; its holding is unchanged at 100% _(~0.6% of mcap)_.

**Oseaspre Consultants** — **Nimesh Sahadeo Singh makes an open offer for 1,82,000 shares, 26% of emerging capital, at Rs 48 a share**, triggered by a board-approved preferential issue of 5,00,000 shares at that price that would leave him with 46.43%.

**Technojet Consultants** — the **same acquirer makes a mirror open offer, 1,82,000 shares for 26% of emerging capital at Rs 48**, on a share purchase agreement of 18 September with the promoters and the same preferential-issue structure.

**Goyal Salt** — board approves investing **up to Rs 3 crore in subsidiary Goyal Foods Industries** and has subscribed 7,65,000 shares for Rs 76.50 lakh in that subsidiary's rights offer, for its capital expenditure and working capital _(~1.7% of mcap)_.

**Puravankara** — wholly owned Provident Housing **launches Phase 6 of its Provident Equinox residential project at Venkatapura, Kengeri, Bengaluru** on 20 September, registered with the Karnataka RERA.
**Emami Limited** — Emami Limited has informed the Exchange about public Announcement - Buyback of Shares
